blocks.title: Text Particles
blocks.description: Your text assembles and dissolves as a swarm of glowing particles. Control spread, size, particle color, particle size, density, and speed

blocks.title: 3D Book Mockup
blocks.description: Wraps your image into a realistic 3D book with a spine and shadow. Upload any cover, then adjust thickness and spine color to match your look.

blocks.title: Kinetic Dot Glitch
blocks.description: Your text rendered as a dot matrix that glitches, scatters, and reforms in an animated loop. Tweak text size, line spacing, dot size, effect speed, transition, and seed for a different chaos pattern

blocks.title: Ferris Wheel
blocks.description: Images rotate in a circular layout like a slow spinning wheel. Upload your media and tweak the panel size, overlap, border radius, and speed to get the motion just right.

blocks.title: 3D Media Cloud
blocks.description: Your images scatter into a 3D cluster. Upload your assets, tweak the size and corner rounding, and toggle the transitions and rotation to control how it builds.

blocks.title: 3D Mackbook Mockup
blocks.description: Drop your image or video into a 3D MacBook mockup. Change the laptop color, fine-tune the screen's brightness and reflection, and choose how it rotates and transitions in and out.

blocks.title: Prism Logo
blocks.description: 3D text with a soft iridescent sheen; apply a color tint, and add surface scratches.

blocks.title: Heatmap
blocks.description: Turns your photo into a thermal, heat-mapped version of itself. Pick your color range and adjust the blur and brightness until it looks how you want.

blocks.title: Machine
blocks.description: Your assets wrap around a tilted, rotating conveyor-belt cylinder; set roller diameter, belt thickness, spacing, corner rounding, speed, and shading.

blocks.title: Glow Outline
blocks.description: Your image's outline draws itself in a glowing neon line, animating around the silhouette until fully lit.

blocks.title: Spread
blocks.description: A motion text component where typography breaks into horizontal slices that move independently before falling into place.

blocks.title: Snap
blocks.description: Text fills the screen in a customizable grid of columns and rows, with individual letters randomly expanding and shifting out of place, then snapping back into position.

blocks.title: Textnado
blocks.description: A looping text scroll that continuously cycles through your list of words

blocks.title: Boost
blocks.description: Letters zoom, scatter, and tumble into each other for text that never sits still.

blocks.title: Bounce
blocks.description: Each letter launches upward independently, then falls back down and exits through the bottom of the frame.

blocks.title: Pulsing Neon
blocks.description: Text that scrolls and bleeds into itself with a glowing, layered effect.

blocks.title: Distorted Text Tube
blocks.description: Glowing text repeats and stretches outward in a chromatic, tunnel-like pattern; tweak font, text, color, size, line/repeat spacing, cycle speed, distortion, glow, and chromatic aberration.

blocks.title: Text Focus
blocks.description: A grainy, blurred text grid pulses through soft focus while colors and contrast invert; set font, text, size, line spacing, shift amount/speed, color invert rate, blur strength/scale, and colors.

blocks.title: Fold Distort
blocks.description: Text splits into two halves that fold, rotate, and distort through a dramatic 3D crease animation. Set left and right text independently, then control speed, hold time, font, and color.

blocks.title: Glow Cycle
blocks.description: Text that pulses with a slow, glowing light cycle. Pick your colors, adjust the spread, outline, and crunch to control how the glow builds and fades.

blocks.title: Gallery Sphere
blocks.description: Your media arranged across a rotating 3D sphere

blocks.title: Floating Showcase
blocks.description: Images scattered across the canvas, drifting with no fixed grid.

blocks.title: Bento
blocks.description: Media arranged in a clean, bento-style grid

blocks.title: Cone
blocks.description: Your images scroll in vertical columns with a curved, cone-like perspective.

blocks.title: 3D Rotation Showcase
blocks.description: A grid of cards each holds briefly, then rotates in 3D to reveal your next image; set hold time, transition speed, corner radius, and card size

blocks.title: Blurred Orb
blocks.description: Cards drift and tumble erratically through soft-focus space; adjust rotation speed, erraticness, item size, border radius, spacing, distortion, and edge blur.

blocks.title: Media Wheel
blocks.description: A stack of images that loops on a curved carousel path. Upload multiple cards and tweak size, gap, radius, curve, speed, and motion type.

blocks.title: Fisheye Carousel
blocks.description: Images arc through a curved, fisheye-warped carousel; set speed, spacing, corner radius, lens radius/strength, and step mode.

blocks.title: Swiping Slideshow
blocks.description: Your photos and videos displayed as a stack of cards, swiping one after another. Load up your assets and tweak the rotation, speed, direction, and cropping.

blocks.title: Image Pinwheel
blocks.description: Your media spawn outward and spiral into a swirling pinwheel collage; set asset size, corner radius, spawn rate/radius, growth speed, and spiral speed/tightness.
